name: riven-exec
description: Riven OSS executive plugins — Pulse analytics, Collective retrieval, and the Exec Workspace assistants (setup, guide, optimize, reminders). Install all three. Add this repo as a marketplace by URL so installs survive a restart.

plugins.name: pulse
plugins.description: Read-only MCP access to the Glowming Pulse analytics API (daily snapshot, weekly digest, and the nine data marts), plus the pulse-brief executive briefing skill.

plugins.name: collective
plugins.description: Read-only MCP access to The Collective retrieval gateway — search Alice + ask the personas — plus the ask-collective skill.

plugins.name: exec-workspace
plugins.description: Guided Q&A assistants for a Riven exec's Claude workspace: exec-setup (install all three exec plugins), exec-guide (how to actually use them — the start/end-session habit, plus the Collective web app where conversations are saved and can be shared with another exec), exec-optimize (tune efficiency, skills/MCP, and run a security sweep — without removing your work) and exec-remind (dated reminders on your own Microsoft To Do). No MCP, no token.
